content: Yawé Muitsexi mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: —Mɨpaɨ ketinemaika Kakaɨyari tewiyari pepayani Parahuni hɨxie. 'A'iwa 'Aruni 'aniukame payani.
'Ekɨ pɨ'ahɨritɨarika naime pemɨtikuxaxatɨwani kenematikuhɨaweni, 'a'iwata 'Aruni Parahuni pɨtawawirieni mɨwapitɨanikɨ memɨyehukɨ mɨkɨ kwieyaritsie.
Ne Parahuni 'iyarieya nepɨtseiriya tsepa 'inɨari mamariwaweme nemutiwewi 'Ekipitu.
Mɨkɨ pɨkaxe'enieni, hikɨ matsi ne naime netɨrɨkariya 'Ekipitu nepɨtiwewieni, mariwemekɨ netiyurienetɨ kemɨtiheitserie, nepɨwarayewitɨni kwinimieme memɨyupaɨme neteɨterima 'ixaheritsixi.
Kepauka ne mariweme nemɨtiyurieni 'Ekipitu kwieyaritsie, kepauka ne 'ixaheritsixi nemɨwarayewitɨni, 'ana 'ekipitutari mɨpaɨ mepɨtehetimani kename ne Yawé nehɨkɨ.
Muitsexi 'itsɨya
Muitsexi 'Aruni hamatɨa yamekatenikakɨne Yawé yemekɨ kemainekai.
Kepauka Parahuni hɨxie memutiniu, Muitsexi nauka tewiyari wiyari kanexeiyakaitɨni, meta 'Aruni nauka tewiyari heimana haika wiyari kanexeiyakaitɨni.
Yawé Muitsexi 'Aruni mame mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe:
«Kepauka Parahuni 'inɨari mɨxewawirieka, 'Aruni ketineutaxatɨa, kɨye 'itsɨyari ke'utikweni kwiepa ke'ikahɨani Parahuni hɨxie. Mɨpaɨ 'ana kɨye kuu kanayeimɨkɨ».

Muitsexi 'Aruni hamatɨa Parahuni hetsɨa mekanekɨne, mekatenaye'atɨani Yawé kemɨtiwarahɨawekai. 'Aruni yu'itsɨ nehɨani kwiepa Parahuni hɨxie meta memɨte'i'uximayatsirie wahɨxie, mɨkɨ kɨye kuu kanayani.
Peru Parahuni memɨtemaiwawe kaniwaruta'inienita meta memɨteyukewaiya, mɨkɨta 'awie memɨte'uyematekɨ mɨkɨ temaiwawemete yaxeikɨa mekateniuyurieni:
Yuxexuitɨ yu'itsɨ mekanexɨriexɨani, yaxeikɨa naitɨ kɨyexi kuuterixiyari mekanakɨne. Matsi 'Aruni kɨyeya mɨkɨ wakɨyexi yunaime kaniwarutikwani.
Mɨya tiuyɨku Yawé kemɨtiwarahɨawekai, Parahuni yu'iyari kaniutseiriya pɨkawaru'eni kememɨtekuxatakai.
Xuriya kememɨte'unetɨa
Yawé Muitsexi mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: «Parahuni yu'iyari pɨtse'iriya pɨkayuwaɨri neteɨterima mɨwatatuanikɨ.
Kenemie ximeri mɨ'ɨwamietsie kenekwewieka Niru hatetsitayaritsie, hikɨ pekananukukemɨkɨ pe'enukunakeke 'akɨye pe'akwetɨ kuu mayeika.

Mana mɨpaɨ ketinetahɨawi: “Yawé hepɨrayutsixi wakakaɨyari pɨnetsiheyenɨ'a mɨpaɨ nematitahɨawekɨ: ‘Keniwarupitɨa neteɨterima memayekɨnekɨ, memɨnetsihayexeiyanikɨ humapaitɨ makumawetsiepai.’ Hikɨ pemɨka'awaɨriyakɨ,
Yawé mɨpaɨ kanaineni: ‘Hikɨ pepɨretimani kename ne Yawé nehɨkɨ.’ 'Ikɨ kɨye nemekwe'ekɨ haa Niru mieme nekaniwamɨkɨ, hikɨ mɨkɨ haa naitɨ xuriya kanayeimɨkɨ.
Tsapari yunaitɨ mekanikwikuni, haa 'axa'u'ɨatɨ kanayeimɨkɨ, 'ekipitutari mana mepɨkatihareni”».

Yawé Muitsexi mɨpaɨta katiniutahɨawe: «'Aruni mɨpaɨ ketineutahɨawi, yu'itsɨ ke'utikweni hapa keheitatsera 'Ekipitu miemetsie, naitɨ 'akite, hamuyehapane, meta haa mukamarike mukumane xuriya mayanikɨ. Xuriya puxɨaweni naitɨ kemɨyewa 'Ekipitu kwieyaritsie, kɨyexi tsiepaitɨ, tetexi tsiepaitɨ naitɨ».

Muitsexi 'Aruni hamatɨa Yawé mekananu'enieni kemɨtiwa'aitɨakai. Parahuni yaxeikɨata memɨte'i'uximayatsirie wahɨxie 'Aruni yɨkɨye teikɨ netsera haa Niru mieme kaniuwani. Hikɨ naitɨ haa mana mieme xuriya kanayani.
Tsapari mekaniukwini Niru hetsie memɨye'uwakai, haa 'axakaniu'ɨakaitɨni 'ekipitutari mana memɨhareka mepɨkayɨwawekai. Naitsarie 'Ekipitu kwieyaritsie xuriya hayari kanixuawekaitɨni.

Yaxeikɨata temaiwawemete 'awie memɨte'uyematekɨ mɨkɨ 'ekipitutari yaxeikɨa mekateniuyurieni, mɨpaɨ Parahuni yu'iyari kaniutseiriya kemainekai Yawé kemɨtiwarahɨawekai, 'Aruni pɨka'anu'eni meta Muitsexi.
Wa'atɨtɨ tixaɨtɨ 'atsipɨkatiɨyɨ ta'aurie haweka yuparatsiyuta kaneyani.
Hikɨ 'ekipitutari putsu mekaniutiwewietɨkɨne Niru hatetsitayaritsie, haa 'aixɨa mɨ'ane mehauwautɨkaitɨ, memɨkayɨwawekaikɨri hatɨa mieme memɨtiharenikɨ.
Temutsi kememɨte'unetɨarie
'Atahuta tukari panukatɨa kepauka Yawé Niru hayari muwa.
